bio: Join Brewhemia for an indulgent Afternoon Tea in Edinburgh. Just a stone’s throw from Edinburgh Waverley station, right in the heart of the city centre. Their famous Afternoon Tea comes from a rich Victorian tradition of spending an afternoon partaking in all manner of bitesize delicacies, in the very best of company.  Their story is one steeped in adventure, a love of great food, drinks and a passion for theatrics. A haven for those with a thirst for discovery, indulge your senses and share in the wonder of Brewhemia.  Served in the Caffe, inspired by the elegance of Venice in a spacious yet intimate setting it’s the perfect place to spend your afternoon right in the heart of Edinburgh.  The Executive chef has created a delicious bespoke version of the classic Afternoon Tea. They have fused Scottish flavours with traditional staples, it makes for a delightfully decadent 3-tiered stand. Enjoy a selection of sandwiches, savouries, cakes and fresh-baked scones, served with your choice of tea or artisan coffee.  For the sophisticated man about town, the Caffe and Bothy spaces at Brewhemia also make for a stylish backdrop to experience the famous Gentleman’s Afternoon Tea. Click here for more information.
